description: SDPA backward with an additive bias and, on most draws, dBias over hipkernel:flydsl_sdpa_bwd_split on gfx942 and gfx90a (COVERAGE.md 9.1 and 9.2): a rank-4 bias of the data dtype or, beside 16-bit data, f32 with an f32 dBias (BI-2), broadcast over batch and head (BI-1, BI-3) or, without dBias, over query rows; any key length, so the bias row pitch is aligned or not (a 16-bit bias with an unaligned pitch is served by dQ rows that read it directly; with dBias the dBias stride must be a multiple of 16 bytes, BI-9, which the constraint keeps). No mask: a bias with a causal or window mask is declined (MW-10) and drawn by SdpaBackward/FlydslBwdSplitProbe. Head dims in the `hd` axis include 160 and the 256 and 512 tiles. The bias and dBias tensors are named z_attn_mask and z_dbias so that their canonical uids (by sorted name, bundle_utils.canonical_uid_map_by_name) are 9 and 10, after the template's stats. The O and the LSE come from the forward with the graph's own bias (CpuFpReferenceSdpa).

derive.stride_q: [sq*row_q, dqk, row_q, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hq*sq*row_q, sq*row_q, row_q, 1]
derive.stride_k: [skv*row_k, dqk, row_k, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hkv*skv*row_k, skv*row_k, row_k, 1]
derive.stride_v: [skv*row_v, dv, row_v, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hv*skv*row_v, skv*row_v, row_v, 1]
derive.stride_o: [sq*row_o, dv, row_o, 1] if layout == 'bshd' else [hq*sq*row_o, sq*row_o, row_o, 1]
derive.dom_kind: 'fixed' if domain == 'constant' else ('free' if domain in ['default', 'narrow', 'wide', 'positive'] else domain)
derive.dom_lo: -0.01 if domain == 'narrow' else (-8 if domain == 'wide' else (0.25 if domain == 'positive' else (0.5 if domain == 'constant' else -1)))
derive.dom_hi: 0.01 if domain == 'narrow' else (8 if domain == 'wide' else (4 if domain == 'positive' else (0.5 if domain == 'constant' else 1)))
derive.eff_placement: 'exact' if placement == 'under' and alignment < 2 else placement
derive.dims_bias: [bias_b, bias_h, bias_q, skv] if bias_rank == 4 else ([bias_h, bias_q, skv] if bias_rank == 3 else [bias_q, skv])
derive.stride_bias: [bias_h*bias_q*pitch, bias_q*pitch, pitch, 1] if bias_rank == 4 else ([bias_q*pitch, pitch, 1] if bias_rank == 3 else [pitch, 1])
derive.dims_dbias: [bias_b, bias_h, bias_q, skv] if bias_rank == 4 else ([bias_h, bias_q, skv] if bias_rank == 3 else [bias_q, skv])
derive.bias_lo: -1 if bias_dom == 'default' else (-8 if bias_dom == 'wide' else -1000)
derive.bias_hi: 1 if bias_dom == 'default' else (8 if bias_dom == 'wide' else 1000)
derive.bias_mag: 1 if bias_dom == 'default' else (8 if bias_dom == 'wide' else 1000)
derive.dom_mag: 0.5 if domain == 'constant' else (8 if domain in ['large', 'wide'] else (4 if domain == 'positive' else (0.01 if domain == 'narrow' else (0 if domain in ['zeros', 'subnormal'] else 1))))

constraints.reason: dBias with a bias broadcast over query rows is declined by every engine (BI-4); SdpaBackward/FlydslBwdSplitProbe draws dbias_rowbcast

constraints.rule: not dbias or skv % (8 if dtype != 'float' and bias_dt == 'same' else 4) == 0
constraints.reason: a dBias stride that is not a multiple of 16 bytes is declined (BI-9, [layout]); the bias itself may have any row pitch on the split engine (9.2), so skv is free without dBias. SdpaBackward/FlydslBwdSplitProbe draws dbias_unaligned

constraints.rule: bias_dt == 'same' or (dbias and dtype != 'float' and dqk == dv and dqk in [64, 80, 96, 128])
constraints.reason: an f32 bias beside 16-bit Q/K/V is served with an f32 dBias, at head dims 64 and 128 on the split engine (BI-2, 9.2); 80 and 96 are drawn too, because the descriptor listing shows f32-bias dQ rows only at d64, so a decline there is information and an accept must grade

GPU reference cost ceiling, as SdpaBackward.space.json: the case time is linear above 2**26 and the CPU backward reference is serial, so 2**29 keeps the worst drawn case near 24 s (measured on a gfx942 host for the ASM region space)

constraints.rule: s_max <= (168 if dtype == 'float' else (8388 if dtype == 'half' else 16777))
constraints.reason: the largest score |S| (bounded by |scale| * dqk * mag^2, plus |bias|) must keep |S| * 2^-24 below a tenth of the dtype's tolerance: the backward computes P = exp(S - LSE) from a given fp32 LSE, and two correct fp32 computations of S differ by |S| * 2^-24, which exp() passes on to P and the gradients. Beyond that bound the oracle cannot tell a correct engine from a wrong one (scale 2^20 with scores near 1e9 gave NaN in every engine that did not produce the LSE itself)
